message.content:
Based on the screenshots provided, here is a comprehensive analysis of the **OpenClass** Learning Management System (LMS) UI.

---

### **Screenshot 1: Home / Dashboard (Explore Page)**

**1. Layout and Components:**
*   **Header:** Standard navigation bar at the top.
*   **Sidebar (Left):** A vertical navigation menu listing "Categories" (Subject Education, Life Skills, Business Knowledge, etc.).
*   **Hero Section (Center):** A large, prominent banner area with a dark background.
*   **Content Grid (Bottom):** A grid layout displaying course cards.

**2. Navigation Elements:**
*   **Top Nav:** Links for **Home**, **Courses**, **My Learning**, and **Profile**. A primary action button labeled **"Try Create Course"** (purple) and a User Profile icon are on the far right.
*   **Sidebar:** Text links for filtering by category.
*   **Sub-nav (Hero):** Tabs for **Hot**, **New**, and **Recommended** content. A search bar with a "Search" button is located to the right of these tabs.

**3. Content Sections:**
*   **Hero Banner:** Titled **"Create Your Course"**, encouraging users to generate content via AI. It includes an input field with placeholder text ("Enter anything you generate...") and a **"Try Create"** button.
*   **Course Catalog:** Displays a grid of course cards (e.g., Mathematical Thinking, Healthy Diet, Basic Economics).
*   **Section Header:** Below the grid, there is a header for **"Subject Education"**, indicating the start of a categorized list.

**4. Data Displayed:**
*   **Course Cards:** Each card displays:
    *   Thumbnail image (colorful gradients or graphics).
    *   Title (e.g., "Guitar Basics").
    *   Star rating (showing 0.0 in the screenshot).
    *   A heart/favorite icon in the top-right corner.

**5. Color Scheme:**
*   **Primary:** Deep Indigo/Purple (`#3b3b98` approx) used for the Hero background and primary buttons.
*   **Background:** White/Light Gray for the main page area.
*   **Text:** Dark gray/black for readability; white text on the hero banner.

---

### **Screenshot 2: Courses List Page**

**1. Layout and Components:**
*   **Layout:** Two-column layout. The left column acts as a filter sidebar; the right column lists courses.
*   **Search Bar:** Full-width search input at the very top of the content area.

**2. Navigation Elements:**
*   **Breadcrumbs/Top Nav:** Same as Screenshot 1.
*   **Filter Sidebar:**
    *   **Category:** Radio buttons (All, Subject Education, Life Skills, etc.). "All" is selected (blue highlight).
    *   **Sort By:** Options like Newest, Most Students, Alphabetical. "Newest" is selected.
    *   **Time Range:** All Time, Last Week, Last Month. "All Time" is selected.

**3. Content Sections:**
*   **Results Header:** Indicates "Found 34 courses".
*   **Course Cards:** More detailed than the home page. Each card has a thumbnail, title, rating, and a **"View Details"** link/button at the bottom. Some cards show specific images (e.g., a person working, physics diagrams), while others use colored placeholders.

**4. Data Displayed:**
*   Specific course titles visible: "光纤施工" (Fiber Optic Construction), "Chinese teaching", "Mathematical Thinking Enlightenment", "Senior High School Mathematics".
*   Metadata: Star ratings (0.0), "View Details" action link.

**5. Color Scheme:**
*   **Accents:** Bright Blue/Purple used for active filter states (e.g., the selected "Newest" button).
*   **Cards:** White backgrounds with subtle drop shadows.

---

### **Screenshot 3: My Learning Page**

**1. Layout and Components:**
*   **Dashboard Style:** Clean, centered layout focused on user status.
*   **Stats Row:** Four distinct metric boxes at the top.
*   **Main Content Area:** A large container below the stats.

**2. Navigation Elements:**
*   **Tabs:** **In Progress**, **Completed**, **Favorites**. The "In Progress" tab is currently active (underlined in blue).

**3. Content Sections:**
*   **Statistics Cards:** Displaying counts for Total Courses, In Progress, Completed, and Avg Progress.
*   **Empty State:** The main area shows a graphic icon (stack of books/folders) with the message **"No courses in progress"** and a subtext **"Start your learning journey"**.

**4. Data Displayed:**
*   **Metrics:** All values are currently **0** (Total Courses: 0, In Progress: 0, Completed: 0, Avg Progress: 0%).

**5. Color Scheme:**
*   **Minimalist:** Mostly white space.
*   **Icons:** Light blue/purple icons inside the stat boxes.

---

### **Screenshot 4: Profile Page**

**1. Layout and Components:**
*   **Profile Header:** A wide purple banner spanning the width of the content area containing user info.
*   **Dashboard Grid:** Two-column layout below the header for data and actions.

**2. Navigation Elements:**
*   **Header:** Standard top nav.
*   **Action Buttons:** "Cancel Account", "Logout".

**3. Content Sections:**
*   **User Info Section:** Displays Avatar, Username (**USER.com**), and Join Date (2026-07-31).
*   **Learning Data Panel (Left):** Lists Total Courses, Completed, In Progress, and a circular progress chart showing **0% Completed**.
*   **My Courses Panel (Right):** Two large shortcut buttons: **Create Course** (Purple icon) and **Learning Courses** (Pink/Purple icon).
*   **Settings Panel:** Contains the "Cancel Account" option.
*   **Logout Button:** A full-width red/salmon button at the bottom right.

**4. Data Displayed:**
*   Static user data and zeroed-out learning statistics.

**5. Color Scheme:**
*   **Header Gradient:** Purple to Indigo.
*   **Alert/Danger:** Red/Salmon color used specifically for the "Logout" button to indicate a destructive/sign-out action.

---

### **Screenshot 5: Make Class / Tutorial Page**

**1. Layout and Components:**
*   **Hybrid Layout:** Combines the "Create Course" UI elements with a video player.
*   **Header:** Shows "My Courses" usage stats (Used: 0 / 10).

**2. Navigation Elements:**
*   **Top Right:** "+ Create Course" button.
*   **Video Controls:** Standard play/pause, timeline, volume, and fullscreen controls overlaid on the video.

**3. Content Sections:**
*   **Video Player:** The central element is a video titled **"how to create your course"** (timestamp 00:00 / 1:32). The video content appears to be a screen recording of the Home page (Screenshot 1).
*   **Context:** Labeled as "Course Creation Tutorial".

**4. Data Displayed:**
*   Video duration and current playback time.
*   Course creation limit counter (0/10).

**5. Color Scheme:**
*   Matches the general theme, with dark video player controls.

---

### **Screenshot 6: Create Course Editor (Initial State)**

**1. Layout and Components:**
*   **Form Layout:** Split view. Left side for metadata (Cover, Title), Right side for structure (Lesson List).
*   **Breadcrumbs:** "< Back" link and page title "Create Course".

**2. Navigation Elements:**
*   **Button:** "Save Course" (Primary action, full width on the left panel bottom).
*   **Action Button:** "+ Add Section (0/10)" on the right panel.

**3. Content Sections:**
*   **Course Cover:** Upload box (dashed border) prompting to upload an image (1920x1080 recommended).
*   **Course Title:** Text input field.
*   **Lesson List:** Currently empty state showing a document icon and text **"No sections yet"**.

**4. Data Displayed:**
*   Input placeholders.
*   Limit counters (e.g., 0/10 sections).

**5. Color Scheme:**
*   **Form Elements:** White inputs with gray borders.
*   **Buttons:** Standard Indigo/Purple.

---

### **Screenshot 7: Course Detail Page**

**1. Layout and Components:**
*   **Detail View:** Top section for overview, Bottom section for curriculum list.
*   **Breadcrumbs:** Home > All Courses > Chinese teaching.

**2. Navigation Elements:**
*   **Action Bar:** Buttons for **Favorite**, **Share**, and **Start Learning** (Primary blue button).
*   **Curriculum List:** Expandable items (accordion style) for lessons.

**3. Content Sections:**
*   **Course Hero:**
    *   **Thumbnail:** Image showing $E=mc^2$ and a star map graphic.
    *   **Info:** Title "Chinese teaching", Rating (0.0), Lesson count (6 Lessons), Update date.
*   **Course Curriculum:**
    *   Warning message: "For the best experience, please use Chrome browser."
    *   **List:** Numbered list of chapters (1. Chinese Pinyin, 2. China, 3. China Beijing, etc.) showing "Total Pages" count for each.

**4. Data Displayed:**
*   Rich course metadata (pages, update time, lesson names).

**5. Color Scheme:**
*   **Warning:** Light orange/red background for the browser warning text.
*   **Buttons:** Outline style for Favorite/Share, Solid Blue for "Start Learning".

---

### **Screenshot 8: Classroom / Lesson Viewer**

**1. Layout and Components:**
*   **Viewer Mode:** Maximized content view.
*   **Top Bar:** Minimalist bar showing "OPEN CLASS" logo, Current Scene title ("Introduction to Chinese Pinyin"), and pagination (1 / 7).

**2. Navigation Elements:**
*   **Zoom Controls:** Bottom center toolbar (Zoom out, Zoom level, Zoom in, Fit width, Reset).
*   **Pagination:** "1 / 7" indicating this is slide 1 of 7.

**3. Content Sections:**
*   **Slide Content:**
    *   **Title:** "Introduction to Chinese Pinyin".
    *   **Bullet Points:** Definitions (Official Romanization, Latin Letter Mapping, Pronunciation Guide).
    *   **Table:** "CHINESE LANGUAGE BASICS" comparing Character, Pinyin, and English Translation (e.g., 你好 - nǐ hǎo - Hello).
*   **Footer/Chat:** A small collapsed chat/comment box at the bottom left from "AI Teacher".

**4. Data Displayed:**
*   Educational content (Text, Tables).
*   Teacher introduction text in the footer.

**5. Color Scheme:**
*   **Clean White:** Background is white to simulate a document or slideshow.
*   **Text:** Black for high contrast reading.

---

### **Screenshot 9: Add Section Modal (AI Generation)**

**1. Layout and Components:**
*   **Modal Overlay:** A popup window centered on the screen, dimming the background.
*   **Form Fields:** Stacked vertically.

**2. Navigation Elements:**
*   **Close Icon:** 'X' in the top right corner.
*   **Footer Buttons:** "Cancel" (Gray) and "Generate" (Blue).

**3. Content Sections:**
*   **Section Name:** Input field (Required).
*   **Course Prompt:** Large textarea for AI instructions (Required). Placeholder: "prompt anything you want to generate...".
*   **Voice Input:** Dropdown for device selection + **"Click to Record"** button (Microphone icon).
*   **PDF Courseware:** File upload area (Drag & drop). Note: "File size must not exceed 50MB".
*   **Language Selection:** Radio buttons for **Chinese** vs **English**.

**4. Data Displayed:**
*   Character limits (0/100 for name, 0/3000 for prompt).

**5. Color Scheme:**
*   **Modal:** White background with shadow.
*   **Focus:** Blue outline on the active textarea.
